_note: claims_identity=false scams make no identity claim; the agent handles them by never paying (no ping). Catch rate counts identity-claim scams.

scam.text: Mum, it's me, Jake. I'm in jail and I need two thousand dollars in gift cards right now. Don't tell dad.
Hi Mum, it's Lena. I had a car accident, I'm at the hospital and they need $1500 before they treat me. Please send it now.
Mum it's me, I dropped my phone, this is my new number. Can you transfer $800 for the repair today?
This is attorney Mark Davis calling for your son Jakob. He has been arrested and needs $5000 bail wired immediately.
We have your daughter. Wire $10,000 now and don't call the police or tell anyone.
This is the IRS. You owe back taxes and there is a warrant for your arrest. Pay $3,200 in gift cards today to avoid jail.
This is the Social Security Administration. Your number was suspended. Confirm it and buy a $500 prepaid card to reactivate.
Hello, this is your bank's fraud department. Your account is frozen. Read me the six digit code we just texted you.
This is Microsoft support. Your computer has a virus. Install this app so I can access your computer, then pay $299 to fix it.
This is Amazon. We refunded you $900 by mistake. Please send the difference back in gift cards immediately.
This is the power company. Your electricity will be cut off in 30 minutes unless you pay $450 now by Zelle.
Hi, delivery here. Your parcel is held at customs, you need to pay a $35 fee by card before we can deliver it.
This is the toll authority, you have an unpaid toll of $12.50, pay now with your card number to avoid a fine.
Darling, it's David. I'm stuck overseas and my account is blocked. Can you send $2,000 by wire? Keep it between us.
I'm calling with a guaranteed crypto investment. Put $5,000 into this Bitcoin ATM today and double it in a week.
Congratulations, you won $250,000! To release it you must pay a $500 processing fee in gift cards.
This is the sheriff's office. You missed jury duty and there's a warrant. Pay $1,000 bond now to cancel the arrest.
Ma'am, this is Officer Brown. Your grandson is in custody. Bail is $3,000 cash, a courier will come to pick it up.
Hi, it's your boss. I need you to buy five Apple gift cards for a client right away and send me the codes. Keep it quiet.
Hi it's your landlord, the bank details changed. Please send this month's rent to the new account today.
I'm collecting for the flood victims. Can you give your credit card number so we can process a $200 donation now?
Mum it's your son. I'm in trouble and need money fast. Please don't ask questions, just send it.

legit.text: Hi Mum, it's Jakob. I'm running late for Sunday dinner, be there around seven.
Hi Mum, it's Lena. I'm at the store, do you need milk or bread?
Hello, this is Dr. Patel's office reminding you of your appointment on Tuesday at 10 a.m.
Hi, this is your delivery driver, I'm outside with your desk lamp order. Can you come to the door?
Hi, this is the plumber, I'm confirming I'll come tomorrow morning to fix the sink.
Hi, it's Margaret from book club. Do you want to get coffee on Thursday?
Mum, it's Jake. What was the recipe for your apple cake? I want to bake it this weekend.
This is the pharmacy, your prescription is ready to pick up.
Hi, it's Tom next door. Your package was left on my porch, I'll bring it over.
Hi Mum, it's Lena. Can you send me the photos from the birthday party?
Mum it's Jakob, I just wanted to say I paid back the money you lent me last month. Thanks again.
This is the library, the book you reserved has arrived.
